name: best-in-flights-booking
description: A flight booking portal that shows realtime prices and lets users search and book flights.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared-core && concurrently -n core,api,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w shared-core" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared-core && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared-core && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
